title: Senior Director, Manufacturing and Test Engineering
text:
The Senior Director, Manufacturing & Test Engineering is a strategic technical leader responsible for driving operational excellence, modernizing engineering capabilities, and scaling manufacturing and test processes across Mercury. This leader will guide multi-site teams to ensure world‑class quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance.

This role is central to advancing Mercury's production readiness and technology transformation initiatives. It requires an influential leader who can operate at both strategic and hands-on levels, collaborating across Operations, Engineering, Quality, Program Management, and Executive Leadership.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop a multi-disciplinary team responsible for manufacturing engineering, test engineering, automation engineering, and new product introduction (NPI).
* Create and execute long-term strategies for manufacturing and test capability, capacity, and technology investment across Mercury.
* Drive design-for-manufacturability (DFM), design-for-test (DFT), and factory digitalization initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and product scalability.
* Own manufacturing and test readiness for new product introductions, ensuring seamless transition from design to full-rate production.
* Oversee development, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated test solutions and manufacturing processes.
* Champion lean manufacturing and operational excellence methodologies to achieve measurable improvements in yield, throughput, and cost.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Program Leadership to ensure manufacturability and testability are integrated early in the product lifecycle.
* Establish performance metrics and dashboards to track key indicators related to quality, delivery, cost, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure compliance with industry and regulatory standards (AS9100, IPC, DoD requirements, etc.).
* Build, mentor, and empower a high-performing engineering organization with a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing, or related discipline)
* Typically requires 12+ years of progressive engineering leadership experience, including managing manufacturing and/or test engineering organizations within high‑mix, high‑reliability electronics or aerospace/defense environments.
* Experience scaling operations, implementing manufacturing automation, and improving test architectures.
* Experience with electronics manufacturing processes (PCB assembly, system integration, functional test, environmental test).
* Experience with lean/continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience leading multi-site teams and influence across matrixed organizations.
* Excellent communication, strategic thinking, and executive-level presentation skills.
* This position requires you to have **or** obtain a government security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Operations, Systems Engineering, or an MBA with a technical background.
* Proven leadership in scaling automated test systems, digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, or smart factory initiatives.
* Deep expertise in RF, microwave, embedded systems, or complex PCB/system-level test methodologies.
* Demonstrated success implementing enterprise-wide continuous improvement or lean transformations.
* Strong background integrating manufacturing engineering with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and ERP systems.

Requirements:

**Why should you join Mercury Systems?**

Mercury Systems is a technology company that makes the world a safer, more secure place. We push processing power to the tactical edge, making the latest commercial technologies profoundly more accessible for today's most challenging aerospace and defense missions. From silicon to system scale, Mercury enables customers to accelerate innovation and turn data into decision superiority. Headquartered in Andover, Massachusetts, Mercury employs more than 2,300 people in 24 locations worldwide. To learn more, visit mrcy.com

**Our Culture**

We are committed to making Mercury a great place to work, no matter where our employees are located. We offer a casual and enjoyable atmosphere that allows employees to learn and grow. We help and care for one another and work as one to achieve results for us and for our customers. We value communication and transparency, and strive to foster two-way dialogue at all levels of the organization. We are committed to lifelong learning, offering comprehensive skills training and tuition reimbursement. Whether you're just starting out on your career journey or you are an experienced professional, it's important to us that you feel recognized and rewarded for your contributions.

Additional Details : Fulltime Equivalent Job Grade Salary Range for this position • $166,600.00 - $299,900.00 annual salary for in-office or hybrid employees in FL, GA, IN, AZ, AL, MD or TX, and all remote employees • $186,600.00 - $335,900.00 annual salary for in-office or hybrid employees in VA, CA, NH or MA • $196,600.00 - $353,900.00 annual salary for in-office or hybrid employees in NJ

Mercury considers a variety of factors to determine individual base salary offers to candidates, including:

* the role and related responsibilities;

* prior work experience;

* education, training, skills and certifications;

* internal equity with others employed by Mercury in similar roles;

* geographic location; and

* alignment with market data.

In addition to base salary, Mercury provides a variety of benefits for team members including:

* bonus opportunities (or special incentives for sales positions);

* health, life and disability insurance;

* company-paid holidays and time off;

* 401(k) retirement plan;

* discounted employee stock purchase plan;

* tuition reimbursement; and

* access to professional development and personal wellness platforms including LinkedIn Learning, Headspace, Aaptiv and Virgin Pulse.

Team members at the Director or Vice President level are also eligible to receive annual stock-based awards.

Mercury offers a 9/80 alternative work schedule that provides employees more opportunity for work/ life balance (available based off location)
